data.name: Hosting_Publish_Button
data.value: Publish and open the pull request

data.name: Hosting_Publish_Button_What
data.value: Uploads the branch of this run to GitHub and opens a pull request (PR). Your branch does not change.

data.name: Hosting_Publish_Uploads
data.value: {0} saved versions (commit) will be published: {1} from Agent Studio and {2} yours.

data.name: Hosting_Publish_Uploads_What
data.value: The branch of the run starts from yours. Whatever you had not published yet goes up with it.

data.name: Hosting_Publish_NotReady
data.value: This run cannot be published yet. Reason: {0}

data.name: Hosting_Publish_NotReady_What
data.value: Only work approved by an independent reviewer (judge) is published, just as when it is moved to your branch.

data.name: Hosting_Publish_Busy
data.value: The project is busy. You can publish when what is going on ends.

data.name: Hosting_Publish_Busy_What
data.value: A run, a debate or an audit is using the project. Agent Studio does not touch your repository until it ends.

data.name: Hosting_Verdict_NotApproval
data.value: The result of the review is published as a status and a comment. It is not an approval from you.

data.name: Hosting_Verdict_NotApproval_What
data.value: Agent Studio never approves a pull request with your account. Approving stays a task for a person.

data.name: Hosting_Head_Moved
data.value: The pull request changed after the review.

data.name: Hosting_Head_Moved_What
data.value: Someone uploaded changes that the independent reviewer did not see. If they are merged, this work will not count as integrated.

data.name: Hosting_Merge_Hello
data.value: Merging changes the branch {0} on GitHub. Windows Hello is asked every time.

data.name: Hosting_Merge_Hello_What
data.value: Merging and deleting on GitHub do not accept a saved permission.

data.name: Hosting_Rules_Unreadable
data.value: The protections of {0} could not be read. GitHub will apply them anyway.

data.name: Hosting_Rules_Unreadable_What
data.value: Your account has no permission to see them, or GitHub does not show them.

data.name: Hosting_Pending_Offline
data.value: Waiting to sync: there is no connection. It will be tried again at {0}.

data.name: Hosting_Pending_Offline_What
data.value: Nothing is taken as done until GitHub confirms it.

data.name: Hosting_SignIn
data.value: There is no GitHub session. Open a terminal and type: gh auth login

data.name: Hosting_SignIn_What
data.value: Agent Studio uses the session of the gh program. It never sees or stores your access key.

data.name: Hosting_Credentials
data.value: Git could not sign in to GitHub. Check your credential manager.

data.name: Hosting_Credentials_What
data.value: Git does the upload with your credential manager. Agent Studio does not see the key.

data.name: Hosting_RateLimited
data.value: GitHub asks to wait until {0}.

data.name: Hosting_RateLimited_What
data.value: This is the usage limit of GitHub for your account. Agent Studio does not insist.

data.name: Hosting_Config_Refused
data.value: It cannot be published: the repository defines {0} in {1}. Remove that line or publish with your own git program.

data.name: Hosting_Config_Refused_What
data.value: Your repository does not choose where the work goes. It does not choose how you sign in either.

data.name: Hosting_Lfs_Refused
data.value: This project uses Git LFS and Agent Studio does not upload those files. Publish the branch with your own git program.

data.name: Hosting_Lfs_Refused_What
data.value: Uploading them needs a program of the repository to run during the upload.

data.name: Hosting_Sync_Permission
data.value: Sync with GitHub

data.name: Hosting_Sync_Permission_What
data.value: Every few minutes it asks GitHub about your pull requests. The name of the repository and their numbers go out; nothing else of the project.

data.name: Hosting_Deployed
data.value: Deployed

data.name: Hosting_Deployed_What
data.value: GitHub says so. Agent Studio deploys nothing.

data.name: Hosting_Revert_Suspected
data.value: Possible revert, from the message of a saved version

data.name: Hosting_Revert_Suspected_What
data.value: This is a deduction. If it is true, you can reopen the milestone.
